svg.title: The GFMIS request file and its results
svg.desc: An officer with a written assignment picks ready vouchers. The system makes a file and sends it through the outbox. A posting result marks the voucher posted, and a payment result marks it paid and issues the 50 Tawi. A failure goes back to ready and never changes the approved record by itself.
